"'''Cipher Twelve'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].

At an unknown point, he was noted to had risen to the position of [[Cipher Agent]]. He was classed as a member of the old guard who operated prior to the [[Great Galactic War]]. During his activities, he was known to have cultivated allies on the fringe. At some point, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] was noted to had worked alongside the Cipher and commented that Cipher Twelve was the finest agent. By the time Cipher Twelve received his [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] brands, he had become verbally abusive in private.

Ultimately, the odds caught up with him and a [[Hapan]]i royal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] punctured his lungs thus killing the agent. His existence was not known to future agents as Imperial Intelligence rarely spoke about a Cipher Agent's predecessors. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the thirtieth anniversary of the agent's death came and Eckard Lokin remembered the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Cipher after recounting his history to [[Cipher Nine]].
